title: PRIDE IMPRISONED
author: Sangeeta Dey ( Roy)
text:
The brewing tempest
Believed it was swelling.
Nothing mattered in its hazy eyes,
It thought it was supreme.
It armed itself with the deafening trumpet ,
To announce its arrival.
The tiny frail frames wore something more resilient.
FAITH...
Even in the face of the mighty opponent.
Came pelting rain,quietened the uproar.
The wild howls of wind didn`t flee,it got seized
In the downpour.
